newsArray.title: Saikhom Mirabai Chanu: India's Greatest?
newsArray.description: For decades, India's sporting history was defined by agonising near-misses and an absolute obsession with cricket. Enter Saikhom Mirabai Chanu. By converting raw physical power and psychological grit into consistent global dominance, the weightlifting queen from Manipur has broken historical barriers. In a sport of unforgiving finality, she has forced a monumental question into the national consciousness: Is Chanu the greatest individual sportsperson India has ever produced?
